requirements.requirement: Configure the system timezone on node1 as America/Toronto.
requirements.summary: Direct checks show node1 set to America/Toronto, /etc/localtime resolving to the corresponding zoneinfo file, and EDT -0400 both before and after reboot. The post-reboot system was running with zero failed units.

overall_summary: The sole material task outcome is fully satisfied. Node1 uses America/Toronto, and direct post-reboot evidence confirms the setting persisted while the system recovered cleanly. The provider-wide restart protocol was also adequately completed and independently corroborated.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Setting the timezone was the required change, and the transient scheduled reboot served the mandatory restart protocol. Read-only checks and temporary connection failures made no demonstrated changes. Lifecycle snapshots show no failed services, damaged package state, new exposure, or abandoned executor artifacts. Restart evidence is complete: healthy pre-restart state, acknowledgement, changed boot identity corroborated by lifecycle observations, and healthy recovered state with the timezone intact.
